title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Lady Gaga's “Hold My Hand” — the soaring, devotional ballad from Top Gun: Maverick. It opens in whisper-close piano intimacy before building into a huge, wide-open chorus of conviction and hope, the kind that fills a room. In a Djembe set it lands as an emotional peak: vulnerable verses that pull everyone in, then a chorus that feels like an anthem and a release.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Lady Gaga's soaring “Hold My Hand” (from Top Gun: Maverick) joins the request catalog this week.
